summary: Server singleton: pick-up and pick-up-cancel requests coming from the legacy (non-ECS) code, moved in each frame from esv::pickup::PickUpLegacyRequestProxySystem and validated by esv::pickup::PickUpRequestValidationSystem (ProcessLegacyPickupRequests / ProcessLegacyPickupCancelRequests). Element is ls::Variant<esv::pickup::PickUpRequest, esv::pickup::PickUpCancelRequest>. Seen.py context: idle level.

Probably the picker. | Name: Same esv::pickup::PickUpRequest as ValidatedPickUpRequestsEntry, whose +0 is the picking character (HandleValidatedPickUpRequests).
